name: Butterfly Æffect: Papillons à Quatre Mains
source:
You play as Damien, a freshman at a remote college who dreams of erasing his feelings of inadequacy by finding a girlfriend. Drawn through convenience to two sets of potential love interests, he doesn't realize just how unwelcome his presence is until it's too late.

Part 1 is a love letter to the genre and nostalgia for the early to mid-00's, from lovey dovey meetcute CGs to our protagonist’s near-delusional certainty that he can wear any girl down if he tries hard enough.

Part 2 features four standalone endings showing the bloody consequences of that certainty.

[From [url=https://ebicon.itch.io/butterfly-effect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演达米安（Damien），他是一所偏远大学的新生，梦想通过找到女朋友来消除自己的不足感。他被两套潜在的恋爱兴趣所吸引，并没有意识到自己的存在是多么不受欢迎，直到为时已晚。

第1部分是一封写给00年代早期到中期这一类型和怀旧情怀的情书，从可爱的CG到我们的主角近乎妄想的确信，只要他足够努力，他就能让任何女孩失望。

第二部分有四个独立的结局，展示了这种确定性所带来的血腥后果。

[来自[url=https://ebicon.itch.io/butterfly-effect]itch.io[/url]]
